an old man of about seventy, white beard trimmed short, bald crown, heavy-lidded eyes, black wool doublet with a plain white collar
portraits.prompt: An oil portrait painting in the manner of a 16th–17th century Northern European master (Holbein, Rembrandt, Frans Hals): an old man of about seventy, white beard trimmed short, bald crown, heavy-lidded eyes, black wool doublet with a plain white collar. Half-length, three-quarter view, the head small in the picture with a wide band of plain background above it (a quarter of the height), one sitter only, looking near the viewer. Plain dark brown-green background. Soft warm window light from the upper left, deep shadows, visible brushwork, a matte worn paint surface, aged yellowed varnish and fine craquelure, not glossy or airbrushed. Period clothing of a minor lord's household, no crown, no jewels of state, no religious symbols, no text, no signature, no frame. Portrait orientation, 3:4.
